map.输入面部区域与红斑面积占比，评估毛细血管扩张程度: Enter the facial region and erythema area ratio to assess the severity of telangiectasia (broken capillaries).
map.📖 查看「红血丝面积评估 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Telangiectasia Area Assessment User Guide"
map.严重程度按红斑面积占比分级；血管直径按 μm 分型: Severity is graded by erythema area ratio; vessel diameter is classified by μm.
map.面积占比分级：<5% 轻度（毛细血管扩张 I 级）、5–15% 中度（II 级）: Area-ratio grading: <5% mild (telangiectasia grade I), 5-15% moderate (II), 15-30% severe (III), ≥30% very severe (IV); the ratio is capped at 100%. Vessel-diameter classification: <0.2 μm fine vessels (capillary dilation), <1 μm medium vessels (venule dilation), ≥1 μm coarse vessels (venous dilation). Used to assess facial telangiectasia severity and support treatment decisions.
map.💡 红斑面积占比＜5%为轻度，5-15%为中度，15-30%为重度，＞30%为极: 💡 Erythema area ratio <5% is mild, 5-15% moderate, 15-30% severe, >30% very severe telangiectasia.
map.评估结果仅供参考，实际诊疗需由专业医师判断: Results are for reference only; actual diagnosis and treatment should be made by a qualified physician.
map.玫瑰痤疮随访：定期估算红斑毛细血管面积，观察药物或光电治疗后的退缩趋势。: Rosacea follow-up: periodically estimate erythema capillary area to observe regression trends after medication or laser/light therapy.
map.术前沟通：用面积占比直观说明红血丝范围，帮助设定脉冲染料激光的治疗分区。: Pre-procedure communication: use the area ratio to illustrate the scope of telangiectasia intuitively, helping set treatment zones for pulsed-dye laser.
map.居家监测：对比每月同角度照片，自我判断红血丝是否在扩大。: Home monitoring: compare monthly photos taken from the same angle to self-assess whether telangiectasia is spreading.
map.输入：鼻侧两片红斑约覆盖面颊区 8% → 判定轻度弥漫型，建议避烫避辣并记录，必: Input: two patches of erythema on the sides of the nose cover about 8% of the cheek area → graded as mild diffuse type; avoid hot/spicy triggers and keep records; if needed, pulsed-dye laser in divided sessions.
map.面积能代替医生诊断玫瑰痤疮吗？: Can area replace a doctor's diagnosis of rosacea?
map.不能。面积只量化范围，是否伴丘疹、灼热需医师结合病史判断。: No. Area only quantifies extent; whether papules or burning accompany it requires a physician to judge with the medical history.
map.照片怎么拍才可比？: How should photos be taken to be comparable?
map.固定距离、自然光、素颜、同角度，最好同一手机同一白平衡。: Fixed distance, natural light, no makeup, same angle; preferably the same phone with the same white balance.
map.手动网格法误差约 ±10%，仅作趋势参考，别用于精确医学结论。: Manual grid method has about ±10% error; use only as a trend reference, never for precise medical conclusions.
map.红血丝面积评估工具，根据面部区域、红斑面积占比及血管直径，评估毛细血管扩张严重程: Telangiectasia area assessment tool: based on facial region, erythema area ratio and vessel diameter, it grades the severity of telangiectasia and offers grading and improvement suggestions.
